skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA374
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA374. Brings out a girl’s figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer’s hottest trend.
skins.quote: The waves brush away both her makeup and her troubles. If beauty requires decoration, then the ocean itself is embellishment enough for her.

skins.name: Granter of Colors
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Granter of Colors. Roberta's work outfit. With the other operators' help and encouragement, Roberta finally found the time to design a look for herself as well.
skins.quote: The pale models are lifeless, but the brushes and paints in her hand can give them a soul.
